result.title: Emergent Vision-Shaped Thinking in Text-Only Reasoning through Multimodal Training
result.summary: Does multimodal training shape how a language model thinks, even when the input is text only? We test this with targeted causal ablations across 10 multimodal configurations from 6 model families, with matched text-only backbones and cross-family transfer controls. We contrast spatial-imagery tasks that invite mental scene construction with symbol-manipulation tasks solvable by symbolic rules alone. We identify a vision-language axis in hidden-state space and ablate its projection at inference. In Chameleon-7B, this ablation drops accuracy on BIG-Bench Hard (BBH) navigate by 27.6 pp while leaving boolean expressions intact (+5.6 pp), a 33.2 pp double dissociation. The effect is direction-specific and layer-localized, extends to mental-simulation tasks such as mental rotation, paper folding, and perspective taking, and is not explained by task difficulty, reasoning depth, or sequential update load. Together, these results reveal emergent vision-shaped thinking (EVT): text-only reasoning that causally recruits representations introduced or strengthened by vision-language training, without assuming an image-like internal format. The measured effect is spatially concentrated at 7-8B and broadens to non-spatial visual attribute binding in the tested 32B configuration. In dual-path unified models (BAGEL, Janus-Pro), the causal handle localizes to the generation pathway as a compact one-dimensional carrier. The understanding pathway also encodes spatial information in a higher-rank, probe-decodable form, but is not the causal handle. To separate decodability from causal use, we analyze concentration, alignment, and semantic location. These diagnostics explain why behavior, probing, and intervention can diverge. Multimodal training thus reshapes the geometry of text-only reasoning, not just how visual input is processed.

AI.brief_summary: 论文检验多模态训练是否改变纯文本推理方式：在6个模型家族的10种多模态配置上，与匹配的纯文本骨干对比做因果消融，定位到隐状态空间中的「视觉-语言轴」，并对比空间想象任务与符号规则任务的表现。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接关联视觉信息是否被内部状态保留并因果使用的核心问题；其「可解码≠被因果使用」诊断、双层路径中生成通路的低维载体，可供核查 latent 内容与因果贡献分配，但对象是文本输入下的视觉塑造表征而非 LVR 生成机制。
